array_rules: authorized_paths equals V11 authorized_paths_literal byte-for-byte and in order
authorized_actions equals V11 authorized_actions_literal byte-for-byte and in order
forbidden_actions equals V11 forbidden_actions_literal byte-for-byte and in order
review_receipts is exactly three V13 receipt references in role order theory, accounting, red_team

literal_values.rationale: Three distinct exact-V13 GO receipts authorize only the distinct bound test author to write one inert independent test-source file with embedded deterministic controls; all protected/test parsing, import, compilation, execution, seed, child, wrapper, and experiment actions remain locked.

coordinator_decision_schema.target_rule: review_target_manifest_sha256 resolves to the byte-identical retained V13 target manifest; test_source_authorization_amendment_v13_sha256 resolves to this byte-identical retained amendment; source_sha256 equals both the target manifest and literal decision value.

test_source_authorization_amendment.precedence: V13 replaces V12 receipt-reference, target-anchor, decision-rationale, and transition semantics. All V11 authorization arrays, requirements, principal constraints, permitted import surface, and forbidden actions remain exact and unchanged.

review_receipt_reference_schema.rule: For each role, path equals the V13 mapped retained path and sha256 resolves to the byte-identical retained receipt.

rules: id, role, and retained path equal the exact role mappings
reviewer_principal_id is an orchestrator agent ID, differs from the bound test author, and all three reviewer IDs are byte-distinct
review_target_manifest_sha256 equals the retained V13 manifest digest
test_source_authorization_amendment_v13_sha256 equals the retained V13 amendment digest
source_sha256 equals the target manifest source digest
findings is the exact empty JSON array

test_source_authorization_amendment.transition_rule: Three conforming V13 GO receipts are advisory. Only the active Coordinator committing one exact V13 decision changes test_source_authorized to true.
